rosterSeedMaxProcessCpuPercent.label: Pause roster seeding above EveJS CPU (%)

recruitmentCorporation.label: Target corporation
recruitmentCorporation.description: Enter an exact player corporation name or ticker. Use name: or ticker: to resolve an ambiguous match. Blank disables corporation recruitment.

autoRecruitCorporation.label: Automatically recruit eligible bots
autoRecruitCorporation.description: Periodically recruit into the target corporation while Game is running, including newly created bots. Leave off to recruit only with /bots corp inviteall.

apiPort.label: Private API port
apiPort.description: Local connection between Game and the bot driver.

playerCorporationBotLimit.label: Player corporation bot limit
playerCorporationBotLimit.description: Maximum recruited bots per player corporation. Human pilots also count toward the separate total member limit.

playerCorporationMemberLimit.label: Player corporation member limit
playerCorporationMemberLimit.description: Total seats for corporations with a player CEO, including the CEO. Set 0 to use the normal CEO skill limit.

recruitmentBatchSize.label: Bots processed per recruitment batch
recruitmentBatchSize.description: Process 1 to 16 candidates per batch. Smaller batches keep tick work low.

playerCorpProfitSharePercent.label: Player corporation bot profit share (%)
playerCorpProfitSharePercent.description: Share of each bot’s cumulative net profit paid to its player-led corporation. Set 0 to disable new contributions.

botCorpOperationSharePercent.label: Bot-led corporation operation share (%)
botCorpOperationSharePercent.description: Share of successful operation profit paid to corporations with a bot CEO.

corpMinProfitShareISK.label: Minimum corporation payout (ISK)
corpMinProfitShareISK.description: Accumulate small player-corporation contributions until the owed amount reaches this minimum.

refreshExistingPortraits.label: Refresh existing bot portraits once
refreshExistingPortraits.description: On Game startup, back up existing bot portraits and replace them with the bundled avatars. Runs once per GameStore. Turn off before starting Game to keep existing bot portraits.

scifiCorporationNames.label: Famous sci-fi names for new bot corporations
scifiCorporationNames.description: New bot corporations take an unused name from a list of famous science fiction companies (Weyland-Yutani, Tyrell Corporation, Kuat Drive Yards and more). Names in the dashboard's name library come first. Turn off to name them after their specialty.

corporationEmblems.label: Random emblems for new bot corporations
corporationEmblems.description: New bot corporations get a random emblem from the game's corporation logo shapes and colours. Turn off to keep EveJS's default emblem, for example when another add-on supplies PNG logos.

agentMissionsEnabled.label: Assign agent missions automatically
agentMissionsEnabled.description: When autonomous work is enabled, fitted pilots can take level 1 Security, Mining, and Distribution jobs from nearby high-security agents.

maxConcurrentAgentMissions.label: Maximum concurrent agent missions
maxConcurrentAgentMissions.description: Cap new mission assignments across the server. Use 0 to stop new assignments while active missions can finish.
